parts.text: The kinematics pass. `vcut = -0.1` is accepted but has a known semantic risk: EXCLURAD interprets negative values in its alternate `v` mode rather than as a conventional positive cut. I will preserve the requested value, generate the validated full-correction input using eta’s default 6.53 GeV beam energy, then record the warning and produced file in `outcome.json`.

The point passes all physical and table-coverage checks. The requested `vcut = -0.1` is accepted but triggers EXCLURAD’s alternate “v” interpretation, so I am preserving it and recording the warning rather than silently changing it. The input uses the eta default beam energy, 6.53 GeV, and full O(alpha) mode.
